system.description:
The mage accelerates their own perception and action within time, gaining extra speed or an additional action as the world seems to slow around them. Rank 3 lets the caster alter the local flow of time for themselves. In play this grants bonus actions or initiative for a short burst.

Dice Pool: Wits + Athletics (+1 die as a rote)

Adapted to M5 from M20 Time 3; mechanics paraphrased.
